arms.fixed: A (alphabet), P (style150-v2 D), and each refitted dictionary of the same fit and width, applied to every pool
arms.search: 3 pools (O, Om, R) x widths 7/8 x fits F500 (all 500) and Fdev (dev-fit 300, measured on dev-val 100)

goal: Compaction-only control: original vs terser-minified vs shared-style sources on the frozen 500, fixed and refitted dictionaries
m1_gates: 400 of 500 frozen problems; at most 256 entries; median at most 32 and p95 at most 96 selections; at most 10% of selection bits from single-character entries; zero whole-solution entries; compare 128/7 and 256/8. Unchanged.
not_claimed: No M1 qualification, unseen solving, assembly result or BITS profile.

partition.final_heldout: scale500-v1 held-out 100: no separate measurement; only inside all-500 aggregates
partition.rule: scale500-v1 training 400, sha256(seed + id) ascending; first 100 dev-val, rest dev-fit

predictions.K1: Om totals at most 75% of O's source bytes, and refitted L-Om at 256 (F500) uses at least 25% fewer selections than refitted L-O.
predictions.K2: Refitted R at 256 (F500) uses at least 20% fewer selections than refitted Om.
predictions.K3: Under refitted dictionaries at 256 (F500), R has more bytes per selection than Om.
predictions.K4: On Om at 256, D_R costs at least 10% more selections than D_Om.
predictions.K5: On dev-val 100 (Fdev), the order O > Om > R in selections holds at both widths.
predictions.K6: At least 490 of 500 Om sources qualify.

search.proposer: style150-v2 hybrid_chosen with no designed forms (chosen-source spans only), every arm
search.start: fallback alphabet (96), greedy refill, matched80-v3 exact local search
